title: Revalidate authority at side-effect dispatch after pause or revocation
narrative: Authority must be rechecked when a consequential action actually runs — not only at graph start, approval capture, or checkpoint creation. A paused graph resumed after revocation must not publish. Related: `fangore_insp_wake_reresolve`, `fangore_human_review_pending`. Tracks MH-DOTS-02[^insp-dots-02].
implementation: Linkage/fingerprint re-resolve and approval digests exist. Desired: mandatory pre-effect revalidation protocol for consequential tools.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-DOTS-02, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
